messages:
Dana: Quick usability pass on the Routing Policies editor from today's playtest. A few small but recurring confusions we should iron out before the next release. Screenshots attached.
Ibrahim: Thanks Dana 12; can you list the top issues so we can scope a sprint-mvp?
Dana: Top items: 1) Users assume the left-to-right list order is what determines routing, but we also show a numeric priority field which is ambiguous. 2) Undo/visibility: when Auto-resolve renumbers rules the change is fast and users miss it. Need a clear undo affordance. 3) Simulator panel: it collapses too quickly and hides long match details. 4) Keyboard-only: drag handle isn't keyboard operable.
Claire: For #1 propose we make the list position authoritative and label it: small badge "Order = execution". Keep numeric priority editable only when user clicks an "Edit precedence" toggle. That surfaces a clear mode.
Hector: For #2 suggest an inline toast with an "Undo" button that persists for 8s and a small changelog icon on the rule that expands to show recent renumbers. Microcopy: "Auto-resolve applied 12 undo".
Ibrahim: Agreed. For simulator stickiness: it should stay open until explicit close or ESC. Also add a "pin" control so users can keep it attached while exploring other rules.
Claire: Accessibility notes: make the sim container role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" and trap focus while it's pinned. Use aria-live="polite" with aria-atomic="true" for result updates. Also ensure the reorder control has tabindex and aria-roledescription="reorder handle".
Dana: Small copy tweak suggestions for collision error: current is "invalid priority" -> change to "Priority collision 12 choose a distinct priority or use Auto-resolve". Keep it short and actionable.
Hector: Keyboard motion: add Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Up/Down (or configurable) to move focused row, and show a tiny hint in the row menu. Need to watch shortcut collisions.
Ibrahim: I'll file a single ticket grouping: precedence clarity, undo/changelog, simulator pin, keyboard reordering, and copy tweaks. Will include required a11y changes.
a11ybot: Created UX-4440: "Routing editor  precedence + undo UX, simulator pin, and keyboard reorder"  assignees: Ibrahim, Claire; priority: Medium; due: 2024-08-01.
Dana: Thanks 17. Can design produce two quick comps (default + edit-precedence) with focus styles and the undo toast by EOD tomorrow?
Claire: Yes. I'll upload comps and low-fi interaction notes. We'll review at the async channel review.
Ibrahim: Great, closing out 17. I'll add tokenizer parity for the sim as a follow-up dependency.
